tasks.gr9-democracy-human-rights-t3: Topic: Democracy and Human Rights. Cover citizenship, the Constitution, rights, duties, and participation. Ask learners to explain how democratic structures work, analyse the Constitution and Bill of Rights, describe citizen responsibilities, discuss participation methods, or investigate how rights are protected in South Africa.
tasks.gr9-diversity-social-justice-t3: Topic: Diversity and Social Justice. Cover discrimination, stereotyping, gender equity, inclusion, and nation-building. Ask learners to analyse discrimination and stereotyping, propose ways to build inclusive spaces, discuss gender equity, reflect on their own biases, or plan advocacy campaigns.
tasks.gr9-conflict-resolution-advocacy-t3: Topic: Conflict Resolution and Advocacy. Cover negotiation, mediation, respectful dialogue, leadership, and activism. Ask learners to apply negotiation strategies, analyse mediation processes, plan dialogue scripts, develop leadership skills, or create advocacy campaigns for issues affecting young people.
tasks.gr9-physical-education-task-3-t3: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 3. Cover athletics, indigenous games, fitness maintenance, and leadership. Ask learners to compete in timed athletic events, participate in indigenous games, maintain fitness logs, demonstrate leadership, or reflect on athletic progress.
